description:
Get the full reference for one Hyperblur item (an effect, component or block) by slug: title, description, category, tags, a props table (name, type, default or required, description), a JSX usage example, the exact import line, npm dependencies, the shadcn install command and the docs URL.

Use this after search_effects (or when the user names an item) and before writing code that renders the component, so the props you pass are real. It does not return the component source; use get_effect_source for that, or install_effect to add the file to a project.

An unknown slug returns an error that lists every valid slug.

slug.description: Effect slug from search_effects, e.g. "glitch-text" or "tilt-card".

name: get_effect
title: Get Hyperblur effect details
